A block of mass $1$ kg is pushed up a surface inclined to the horizontal at an angle of $60^\circ$ by a force of $10$ N parallel to the inclined surface as shown in the figure. When the block is pushed up by $10$ m along the inclined surface, what is the work done against frictional force? $g = 10\,\text{m/s}^2$.
solution:
Friction $f = \mu mg\cos 60^\circ = 0.1 \times 1 \times 10 \times \dfrac{1}{2} = 0.5$ N

$W = f \cdot d = 0.5 \times 10 = 5$ J
